# ethers 6.13.2 (MIT)

`ethers.umd.min.js` is the existing setup page's pinned dependency, vendored from
`https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/ethers/6.13.2/ethers.umd.min.js` so the new signing page does not need an off-chain script.
Upstream: https://github.com/ethers-io/ethers.js (Richard Moore, MIT).
No model weights, wallet or private key is included. See `ethers-LICENSE.txt`.
